description: This file defines a class EmployeeWorkExperienceSearchFilterParams which extends a base FilterParams class. It is used to encapsulate filter parameters for searching employee work experience records, including allowed sort fields and an employee number property.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates filtering parameters for employee work experience searches, including sortable fields and employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object, setting the default sort field to 'we.jobTitle'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter as an integer or null.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.
